name: expert-roles
description: Choose expert perspectives for Codex and manage their personal installations while preserving existing roles and local edits.

interface.longDescription:
Choose expert perspectives for your work in Codex. Browse the reviewed collection, inspect installed versions, and add or remove one personal expert at a time.

Existing manual roles and local edits are preserved. Requires Python 3.12 or newer on macOS or Linux. Updates, manual-role adoption and project installation are not included.
defaultPrompt: Show available Expert Roles without changing anything.
Inspect my installed expert versions and ownership without changing anything.
